topics.title: National Advisory Board on DR/DME – Eye Health (July 12th, Shanghai)

background.text: National AB on DR/DME planned for July 12th (Saturday, Shanghai). Global Eye Health pipeline to be introduced; clinical development of PKKi and Anti-Sema 3A, and DR/DME in China to be discussed. KEE invitations ongoing.
